name: claude-code-mods
description: Free mods for Claude Code: guards, status lines, message buttons, writing rules.

plugins.name: active-time
plugins.description: Counts the time you really spend with Claude Code (typing and Claude working, not an idle terminal) and shows it in the status line and /claude-time.

plugins.name: agent-watch
plugins.description: Shows one line per running subagent above the prompt: model, task, minutes and its latest tool call

plugins.name: dashless
plugins.description: Rewrites em dashes out of Claude's replies, file writes and edits, and commit/PR messages before they land.

plugins.name: output-ladder
plugins.description: Re-explain the last answer as ASD-STE100 text, a diagram, an HTML page or an explainer video, and score answers for STE style.

plugins.name: quote-buttons
plugins.description: Quote and edit buttons on chat messages, hand-off buttons that open a new Konsole tab with Claude on that message, and a 5 second undo for prompts sent while a turn runs.

plugins.name: save-game
plugins.description: Saves a 3 line card when you stop (doing, next step, open question) and shows it above the prompt next time

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Masks API keys and tokens in tool results before Claude reads them, and blocks a git push that would leak secrets or home paths to a public repo.

plugins.name: session-title
plugins.description: Names each session in 2 to 5 words at the right end of the footer under the prompt, so many open terminals are easy to tell apart.

plugins.name: slopless
plugins.description: Blocks AI sounding text in social media writing (X replies, X posts, LinkedIn posts) and injects the writing rules.

plugins.name: snap
plugins.description: /snap: drag a box on screen with Spectacle and the screenshot goes into your next message.

plugins.name: spiral-stop
plugins.description: Stops fix loops: when the same error returns after 3 fix attempts, tells you and Claude to stop and rethink

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Shows your Claude 5 hour and weekly rate limits in the status line and warns at 80% and 90%.
